## [1.1.0-dev.1](https://github.com/johninnl/nl-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0-dev.1) (2026-10-31)

### ✨ New Features

* **ED:** add GVA and ED sibling patch controls ([fe9f035](https://github.com/johninnl/nl-morphe-patches/commit/fe9f0355bcdbb8739459330be06272aae2b3a931))
* **GVA:** add GVA and ED sibling patch controls ([fe9f035](https://github.com/johninnl/nl-morphe-patches/commit/fe9f0355bcdbb8739459330be06272aae2b3a931))

## Dev testing

- GVA 22.0.0 / 2012316104: Hide ads, Disable tracking, Skip consent screens, Hide Premium banner.
- ED 9.22.0 / 9220000: the same four controls plus Read full articles.
- Use the complete publisher APKS split sets for these exact builds.
- Original, individual and combined patch selections pass; Android bundle build, full DEX validation, signing checks and 91 input-guard assertions pass. Python: 331 tests passed (34 skipped); release/identity tests: 29 passed.
- The bundle is signed with the repository public key. The test kit includes checksums and a phone acceptance checklist.

Phone runtime and live publisher article availability still need user testing. **Main and the latest stable release are unchanged. Promotion to main requires explicit user confirmation.**
